execution_context: The same versioned input bundle is available in every documentation condition. File roles tng_path, h5md_path, mmcif_path, gsd_path, tpr_path, edr_path, xvg_path and fasta_path identify actual inputs in those formats. small_pdb_path and imd_trr_path identify a small topology and trajectory. Existing protein-system paths and preloaded universe/atoms remain available. For an IMD or StreamReaderBase target only, a controlled local IMDv3 server is already running: imd_url (str), imd_host (str), imd_port (int) and imd_n_atoms (int) are available; construct the actual documented reader and close it when done. For legacy X3DNA operations, dna_pdb_path is a DNA structure and x3dna_executable is the installed official executable path. The child process already has X3DNA and PATH set for this tool. Output files belong under output_dir. These are input/environment facts, not expected result values. chemfiles_trajectory_path is the trajectory validated with the Chemfiles backend. fixture_catalog_path is a JSON catalog of additional public MDAnalysisTests2.11 inputs; its files entries provide path, relative_path and suffix. The catalog also includes deliberately malformed/negative specimens, so choose data suitable for the intended format. New deterministic synthetic data may be created under output_dir; never modify supplied files.
